content: In addition, as shown in Figure FIGREF19, the perturbation effectiveness of Deletion, Mask, and Grammatical Replacement varies from strong to weak. In the following experiments, we choose Mask as the representative perturbation operation for its moderate perturbation performance, based on which we compare two most effective methods Attribution and Attention.
